title: AIDSO leads protest against magnet school scheme, ADB agreement

ai.summary: Villagers, parents and students in Karnataka staged a protest against the state government's magnet school scheme and ADB agreement, claiming it would close 45,326 government schools and undermine public education.

facts.quote: the remaining 45,326 schools will eventually be closed in the name of merger
Of the nearly 49,000 government schools in the State
the Congress government has proposed to retain only 3,674 Karnataka Public Schools (KPS)

facts.claim: 2,000 schools handed over to private institutions
facts.quote: hand over 2,000 schools to corporate companies and private institutions in the first phase
more than 70,000 teacher posts are vacant
around 7,000 schools are functioning with a single teacher

ai.background_note: The protest is part of a larger movement against the Karnataka government's education policy changes, which critics say prioritize corporate interests over public education.
